page: Google Cloud Platform n4-standard-4 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the n4 server family. It is configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical Intel x86_64 cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance features 16 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, relying on network-attached storage for persistent disk operations.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the n4-standard-4 delivers average single-core capabilities, as evidenced by its stress-ng single-core CPU score of 1561.99 and Geekbench single-core score of 1807.0. However, multi-core and memory-intensive operations fall into the lower performance tier. Multi-core performance metrics, such as the Geekbench multi-core score of 4100.0 and stress-ng multi-core score of 3213.05, are relatively weak. Memory bandwidth tests also show lower-tier performance, with uncached read speeds at 32.36 GB/sec and write speeds at 21.01 GB/sec.

Despite lower multi-threaded performance, the processor supports advanced instruction sets, including Intel Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for AI and vector calculations. These hardware features support specialized tasks like cryptography and integer manipulation, with the Passmark CPU encryption test achieving average tier results. Small-scale language model inference also shows average performance for text generation at 118.57 tokens per second using a 135M model, though prompt processing speeds remain in the lower tier.

Given its balanced resource ratio and moderate single-core performance, this instance is suited for general-purpose workloads such as static web serving, where it achieves a throughput of 6.53 GB/sec, and basic text processing. It is less optimal for memory-bound databases, heavy multi-threaded software compilation, or complex ray tracing due to its lower multi-core and memory bandwidth profiles.
description: Google Cloud Platform n4-standard-4 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance featuring 4 dedicated vCPUs and 16 GB of RAM, powered by an Intel x86_64 architecture with 2 physical cores. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs. Performance benchmarks show average single-core CPU execution and static web serving throughput of 6.53 GB/sec, alongside hardware-accelerated support for Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and AVX-512. However, multi-core processing, memory bandwidth, and database operations perform in the lower tier, as shown by a Geekbench multi-core score of 4100.0. This instance is best suited for light general-purpose workloads, static web serving, and basic single-threaded applications rather than memory-intensive databases or heavy multi-threaded computing.
